topic: A person learns their childhood best friend doesn't remember them
text: In the mist of our days, there was a silence that grew between us, unspoken, yet vast. I sought the familiar corners of our shared history, the laughter lingering in the air, only to find the rooms transformed, the echoes of our play now a distant whisper. My childhood, a tapestry woven with threads of our moments, seemed to fray at the edges where we touched. Yet, in the face of this newfound absence, a strange clarity unfolds. It’s as if the world, in its infinite complexity, begins to reshape itself, allowing new patterns of light to dance through the gaps. I find myself not grieving the loss, but marveling at the way memory, like the weather, shifts and moves, revealing the ever-changing landscape of our lives.
